name: localnote
description: Lokale RemNote-Alternative: Outliner-Notizen, automatische Karteikarten, FSRS-Lernmodus.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop ci && npm --prefix desktop run dist:win
